name: std::generator<Ref,V,Allocator>::begin
intro:
Pushes coroutine_ into *active_ stack, then evaluates coroutine_.resume().

Before invocation of begin() the coroutine_ must refer to a coroutine suspended at its initial suspend point.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator whose coroutine_ member refers to the same coroutine as coroutine_ does.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: It is an undefined behavior to call begin() more than once on the same generator object.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Yield two values, transfer ownership, and propagate an exception. Requires a conforming generator implementation; libstdc++ 14.2 has a missing return in its move-assignment implementation.
